description: Source file containing utility functions for testing and manipulating disk cache entries, including corrupting files and modifying headers.

methods.name: CreateCorruptFileForTests
methods.description: Creates a dummy file for testing purposes, potentially corrupting a cache entry.

methods.name: RemoveKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Removes the SHA256 key hash from a cache entry file.

methods.name: CorruptKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Corrupts the SHA256 hash data in a cache entry file.

methods.name: CorruptStream0LengthFromEntry
methods.description: Modifies the stream size in the cache entry header to an invalid large value.
